description: What is about to change: the laws already published and recorded that take effect after today, within the next days (90 unless given), in one jurisdiction or all, the soonest first, each with the day it takes effect, how many days away that is and how many provisions it changes. Use it for "what comes into force soon", "upcoming changes", "what do we need to prepare for". For what a law will change, call law_details with its corpus_commit; for a provision's text from that day, read_law with that date.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, counted from tomorrow (default 90, at most 3660).

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

max_results.description: At most this many (default 100, at most 500).

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

name: upcoming_changes
title: Upcoming changes
